purpose: Identify hot operations in the frozen fixed-layout Rust runtime before the three-line lazy-error correction.
commands: perf record -F 999 -e cpu-clock:u --call-graph dwarf,16384 -o build/profile/cpu-musl.data -- build/runtime-v3/bin/native/cpu 32
perf record -F 999 -e cpu-clock:u --call-graph fp -o build/profile/cpu-musl-fp.data -- build/runtime-v3/bin/native/cpu 32

limitations: Sampled self-time percentages are estimates, not per-site allocation counts.
DWARF unwinding did not yield caller chains for this native32 executable. Frame-pointer sampling recovered Rust call paths but many allocator stacks remain truncated or contain unknown addresses.
Both profiles measure the frozen pre-lazy-error executable, not the corrected source or a shared-LTO build.
